classification_basis: Initial security/workflow audit with path/range normalization. Candidate statuses are not implementation claims.

plugins.name: _api
plugins.summary: Host plugin plumbing: audio playback, header/user-area buttons, profile collections/sections and surface attributes injected by patching Discord React modules; no end-user feature.
plugins.bounds: No Serein grant or UI scope; module surface is unbounded by design.
plugins.target: No port target; Serein's extension host owns its own SDK surfaces.

plugins.name: _core
plugins.summary: ConcatenatedModules enumerates icon modules concatenated by Discord's bundler and patches the loader to build an icon map.
plugins.bounds: Reads the whole Discord bundle; no bounded Serein analogue.
plugins.target: No port target; Discord bundle internals.

plugins.name: advancedPermissions
plugins.summary: Shows the advanced permissions card by default and can hide or collapse Discord's simplified permissions card.
plugins.bounds: Permission-editor UI only; loaded permission data.
plugins.target: Already native in crates/ui/src/channel_permissions.rs; no duplicate needed.

plugins.name: altKrispSwitch
plugins.summary: Rewrites Discord's noise-suppression popout to switch between None and Krisp.
plugins.bounds: Voice popout only; adds no audio capture or processing.
plugins.target: Already native: crates/ui/src/voice.rs and voice_settings.rs expose Off/Suppression; Serein does not use Krisp.

plugins.name: alwaysExpandProfiles
plugins.summary: Opens the full profile modal instead of the profile popout.
plugins.bounds: Loaded profile only; one local UI preference.

implementation.limitations: Optional full profile layout; webhooks and docked DM panel keep compact behavior; privacy gating unchanged.

plugins.name: animalese
plugins.summary: Downloads 30 WAV assets from raw.githubusercontent.com and synthesizes and plays animalese audio for each message.
plugins.bounds: 30 files, 50-char text limit, no byte cap; requires external network and autoplay.
plugins.target: Unsuitable; would need bundled assets and a bounded native audio path.

plugins.name: atSomeone
plugins.summary: Pre-send replaces @someone with a random loaded guild or DM member ID.
plugins.bounds: One random ID per message; can create unsolicited mentions.

plugins.name: autoJumpToMessage
plugins.summary: On a notification event, transitions to the channel unless the window is focused or the source is muted.
plugins.bounds: One navigation per event; loaded channel and mute state only.
plugins.target: Bounded native capability: add a notification event and gated navigation.

plugins.name: autoZipper
plugins.summary: Intercepts drop or paste, recursively reads files and folders, zips them and opens the upload picker.
plugins.bounds: Unbounded file count and bytes; arbitrary local filesystem access.

plugins.name: bannersEverywhere
plugins.summary: Injects user banners into the member list, caches user-to-CDN URLs and converts GIFs via canvas; optionally uses usrbg.
plugins.bounds: Upstream per-user DataStore is unbounded; remote CDN images; no member-list render grant.
plugins.target: Bounded native capability only: native member-list decoration with capped IDs and the existing media cache.

implementation.limitations: Only already cached banner textures behind bounded member rows; never starts a row download, usrbg conversion, or identity cache.

plugins.name: baseDecoder
plugins.summary: Detects base64 in the selected message, decodes and UTF-8 validates it, shows decoded text and copies it.
plugins.bounds: Proposed 8 matches and 4 KiB decoded per match; selected message text only.
plugins.target: Safe extension candidate: message action with selected_message + clipboard_write.

implementation.limitations: Selected-message standard Base64 decoding plus composer replacement; strict UTF-8, at most eight matches/4 KiB decoded each and one Apply-reviewed blank-line-separated copy. No React modal or per-match copy buttons.

plugins.name: betterActivities
plugins.summary: Shows activity icons in the member list and all activities in the profile popout using presence and activity payloads.
plugins.bounds: SDK presence excludes activity payloads; native profile already shows multiple activities; cap member-list entries.
plugins.target: Bounded native capability or no-op; member-list icon layer is native-only.

plugins.name: betterAudioPlayer.desktop
plugins.summary: Fetches audio from the Discord CDN in the native layer and draws WebAudio oscilloscope and spectrograph views on attachment players.
plugins.bounds: Two allowed hosts and a 12 MB maximum; needs native fetch and canvas.
plugins.target: Bounded native capability; Serein already has its own audio player, so native-only.

plugins.name: betterBackreading
plugins.summary: Tunes scroll anchoring, trimming and earlier message/image loading with configurable buffers and history batch size.
plugins.bounds: 30-100 messages per batch; 300-3000 px buffers; local preferences only.
plugins.target: Safe native reading preference in scroll and reading settings.

plugins.name: betterBanReasons
plugins.summary: Adds stored custom ban reasons and delete durations, or a default free-text reason, to the ban modal.
plugins.bounds: Upstream list unbounded; propose 20 reasons x 200 chars; Serein has no native ban action yet.
plugins.target: Bounded native capability after native ban support exists.

plugins.name: betterBlockedUsers
plugins.summary: Searches blocked users, opens profiles, merges blocked/ignored message groups and skips the blocked-profile prompt.
plugins.bounds: Relationships snapshot is 100 records and 4 KiB; native blocked and ignored search already exists.
plugins.target: Already native for search in crates/ui/src/friends.rs; do not port prompt bypass or row merging.

plugins.name: betterCommands
plugins.summary: Auto-fills optional slash-command arguments and adds /refresh to fetch application command indexes; it is not MoreCommands.
plugins.bounds: Discord command internals; /refresh triggers network index fetches.
plugins.target: Unsuitable. UnitConverter and MoreCommands are already_ported in extensions/plugins/offline-composer-tools and must not be re-ported.

plugins.name: betterForwards
plugins.summary: Resends failed forwards as plain messages, bypasses NSFW forwarding restrictions and fans attachments out to multiple channels.
plugins.bounds: Auto-send to many recipients; 5 attachments per chunk; no approval step.

plugins.name: betterImageEditor
plugins.summary: Keeps an avatar and banner image shelf, remembers crops and stores full images plus 160 px thumbnails.
plugins.bounds: 6-100 entries; full image and thumbnail blobs; arbitrary image files.
plugins.target: Unsuitable as an extension; only a bounded native media library could work.

plugins.name: betterInvites
plugins.summary: Adds invite expiry tooltips, inviter headers and click-to-lurk joining for discoverable servers.
plugins.bounds: Invite data plus a server-join side effect.
plugins.target: Already native in invites.rs and join_server.rs; no duplicate.

plugins.name: betterMutualServers
plugins.summary: Adds role chips and join dates to mutual-server rows and requests missing guild members.
plugins.bounds: Two roles shown plus a count; upstream dispatches GUILD_MEMBERS_REQUEST.
plugins.target: Bounded native capability: loaded member details only and no fetch; native profiles already show roles and member-since.

plugins.name: betterPlusReacts
plugins.summary: Uses leading plus signs before an emoji to target an earlier loaded message for the reaction.
plugins.bounds: Proposed 50-message lookback; one reaction proposal.

implementation.limitations: Composer plus-sign lookback over at most 50 loaded messages and one Apply-reviewed add reaction. No shortcode resolution, toggle/removal, draft clearing or raw store access.

plugins.name: blockKeywords
plugins.summary: Locally filters messages matching user keywords or regexes, marks them blocked and can suppress unread and notification handling.
plugins.bounds: Upstream list and regex are unbounded; port literal-only with 100 words x 64 chars and no regex.
plugins.target: Safe candidate as a native local filter.

implementation.limitations: Draft whole-line literal keyword filtering, not incoming timeline blocking or regex.

plugins.name: blockKrisp
plugins.summary: Prevents Discord's Krisp module from loading and reports noise cancellation as unsupported.
plugins.bounds: Voice module only; adds no capture or network.
plugins.target: Already native outcome: Serein's own voice processing does not load Krisp.

plugins.name: bypassPinPrompt
plugins.summary: Replaces pin and unpin confirmation dialogs with direct pin actions.
plugins.bounds: One message action; removes user confirmation.

plugins.name: bypassStatus
plugins.summary: Sends or plays notifications for allowlisted guilds, channels and users even while in do not disturb mode.
plugins.bounds: Allowlists unbounded upstream; propose 100 IDs each; event surfaces cannot emit notification effects today.
plugins.target: Bounded native capability through native notification policy.

plugins.name: channelBadges
plugins.summary: Renders type, NSFW, locked and rules badges on channel rows from loaded channel and guild flags.
plugins.bounds: Fixed ~14 labels; no fetch or writes.
plugins.target: Safe now; small native addition alongside existing channel-type UI in categories.rs.

implementation.limitations: Loaded native kind badges only; NSFW/locked/rules metadata is unavailable and not guessed.

plugins.name: channelTabs
plugins.summary: Browser-like channel tab strip with per-account tabs and bookmarks, unread state, shortcuts and optional view caching.
plugins.bounds: Upstream default is unlimited tabs; propose 20 tabs and 100 bookmarks, IDs only, no view cache.
plugins.target: Bounded native capability; large native UI work, not a plugin-scale port.

plugins.name: cleanChannelName
plugins.summary: Normalizes channel names with NFKC and small-caps mapping, strips emoji and decoration, supports an ignore list and reverts while editing.
plugins.bounds: 100-char channel names; propose 200 ignore IDs; display-only.
plugins.target: Safe candidate in native channel-list rendering.

implementation.limitations: Bounded local display normalization, not full NFKC; per-channel ignore and original name during editing; does not cover every other raw-name surface.

plugins.name: cleanerChannelGroups
plugins.summary: Hides all channels under collapsed categories even when they have unread messages.
plugins.bounds: Channel-list display only.
plugins.target: Already native: categories.rs omits category children when collapsed.

plugins.name: clickableRoles
plugins.summary: Role popout that lists which members have a role. Upstream fetches GET GuildRoleMemberIDs and slices MAX_VISIBLE_MEMBERS; full guild-wide count is network-backed and unavailable.
plugins.bounds: member_details: <=20 loaded members, 32 role IDs/member, 32-role catalog, 6 KiB; no GUILD_ROLE_MEMBER_IDS fetch or total count
plugins.target: Extensions panel action over member_details roles; open_profile Apply

implementation.limitations: Loaded-role/member subset only; no guild-wide endpoint/fetch.

plugins.name: clientSideBlock
plugins.summary: Locally hides messages, members, friends, DMs and active-now cards via many Discord render patches plus a local user block list.
plugins.bounds: render-list suppression across messages/members/friends/DMs/active-now; no render hook; local list fits storage 1 MiB but cannot hide UI

plugins.name: clipUpload.desktop
plugins.summary: Uploads a local video file as a Discord clip using a native dialog, clip footer metadata, ffmpeg and Discord clip upload REST.
plugins.bounds: native file dialog, <=500 MB .mp4/.m4v, clip footer metadata, ffmpeg, Discord clip upload REST; no file/network capability

plugins.name: clipsEnhancements.discordDesktop
plugins.summary: Adds clip FPS, resolution and duration options and Rich Presence clip tagging by patching Discord Clips settings and PresenceStore.
plugins.bounds: no Clips feature in Serein; needs clip timeslot/resolution/FPS settings and RPC tagging; no settings surface

plugins.name: collapsibleUi
plugins.summary: Collapsible channel/member/chat-button/user-area surfaces with pointer tracking and a draggable detached user area.
plugins.bounds: DOM surface providers, CSS-managed heights, pointer tracking, detached draggable user area; appearance=colors/metrics only

plugins.name: commandPalette
plugins.summary: Raycast-style palette with registry, aliases, frecency, pins and hotkeys driving navigation, plugin management and send-DM commands.
plugins.bounds: panel catalog using navigate/home/open_view/open_profile/jump_to_message/search; storage 1 MiB; no global hotkey capture or arbitrary Discord commands; each nav Apply
plugins.target: Extensions panel navigation launcher + storage pins

implementation.limitations: Bounded loaded-channel/native launcher; no global hotkey or arbitrary commands.

plugins.name: contentWarning
plugins.summary: Blurs messages containing configured trigger words and reveals them on hover or click by replacing rendered message content.
plugins.bounds: message-body blur/reveal in renderer; appearance cannot transform nodes

plugins.name: copyProfileColors
plugins.summary: Copies a user's profile gradient themeColors to the clipboard from user and server profile context menus.
plugins.bounds: profile snapshot lacks themeColors; exposes nick/bio/pronouns/avatar/joined_at only; clipboard_write <=4096 B would suffice but no source data

plugins.name: copyStatusUrls
plugins.summary: Right-click an activity button to copy its URL; resolves button_urls through an uncached Discord activity metadata API call.
plugins.bounds: activity button_urls from Discord activity metadata API (network) + activity right-click; presence=status strings only

plugins.name: copyUserMention
plugins.summary: Adds a user context-menu item that copies <@id> for the selected user.
plugins.bounds: clipboard_write <=4096 B with Apply; ID from selected_message_ref.author_id or member_details.user.id; no clipboard read

implementation.limitations: Canonical selected-author mention after Apply.

plugins.name: cursorBuddy
plugins.summary: Renders an animated Oneko or Fatass Horse sprite that follows the cursor, loading remote image sheets.
plugins.bounds: full-window sprite DOM animation + remote GIF/PNG downloads; no overlay drawing or network

plugins.name: customFolderIcons
plugins.summary: Replaces server folder icons with user-imported PNG images stored per folder.
plugins.bounds: imported PNG bytes + per-folder icon override; guild_folders read-only; no file import or per-folder appearance

plugins.name: customSounds
plugins.summary: Replaces Discord sound cues with uploaded audio files or alternative soundpacks through an AudioPlayer processor and DataStore blobs.
plugins.bounds: audio blobs in DataStore, AudioPlayer processor, soundpack replacement; notification_settings=on/off cues+volume only

plugins.name: customStatusTimeouts
plugins.summary: Adds configurable status expiry presets (seconds through months) to the presence menu and sorts Forever on top or bottom.
plugins.bounds: set_own_presence clear_after_seconds 0..86400 (max 1 day), custom status <=128 chars/512 B, Apply; week/month presets impossible

implementation.limitations: Explicit presence Apply proposal with expiry <=86400; no week/month presets.

plugins.name: customTimestamps
plugins.summary: Formats message, tooltip and aria timestamps with Moment.js templates and calendar/relative tokens by patching timestamp rendering.
plugins.bounds: renderer hooks for cozy/compact/tooltip/aria timestamps + Moment.js formats; no render hook or timestamp-format setting

plugins.name: customUserColors
plugins.summary: Stores per-user and per-channel custom colors and applies them to message names, DM list entries and reply previews.
plugins.bounds: per-user/per-channel/DM name-color render overrides; appearance overlay is theme-wide

plugins.name: declutter
plugins.summary: Removes non-essential Discord UI such as profile effects, nameplates, shop tabs, boosts, billing settings, gift button and tooltips.
plugins.bounds: local_settings only: zoom/sidebar/member list/GIFs/media links/smooth scrolling/scroll speed; cannot remove profile effects/nameplates/boosts/shop/billing/gift/tooltips

plugins.name: disableCameras
plugins.summary: Forces self_video off by default when joining calls via a one-line Discord patch.
plugins.bounds: camera_control disables own camera in current call with Apply each time; no persistent default or pre-join enforcement

plugins.name: discordDevBanner
plugins.summary: Shows the Discord developer banner with the client build ID from GLOBAL_ENV.
plugins.bounds: Discord Electron build ID from GLOBAL_ENV; Serein exposes api_version/sdk_revision only

plugins.name: downloadAllAttachments
plugins.summary: Message popover button that fetches and downloads every attachment in a message, optionally including non-media files.
plugins.bounds: attachment URLs absent from message_content (no media URLs/bytes), HTTP fetch of N files, filesystem writes, dedupe naming; no network/file capability

plugins.name: draftNavigator
plugins.summary: Searches unsent drafts across channels, previews their text and jumps to the channel through the draft store.
plugins.bounds: no draft store; composer=current draft only (Some("") if empty); cannot enumerate/search/jump drafts

plugins.name: dragFavoriteEmotes
plugins.summary: Drag-and-drop reordering of favorite emotes, writing the new order to Discord's frecency user settings.
plugins.bounds: favorite-emoji frecency read/write + HTML5 drag-and-drop in emoji picker; no emoji-favorites API or DOM

plugins.name: dragify
plugins.summary: Drags users, channels and servers into chat to insert mentions, links or newly created invites, with a custom drag ghost.
plugins.bounds: DOM drag sessions, ghost overlay, dataTransfer payloads; invites need REST create (partial server_control) but no drag UX; mention insert only via composer/message_send
plugins.target: composer mention insertion only; no drag

plugins.name: elementHighlighter.dev
plugins.summary: Developer element inspector that highlights hovered DOM nodes, shows computed style info and copies CSS color values.
plugins.bounds: elementFromPoint, computed styles, CSSOM scanning, injected tooltip DOM; native egui has no DOM/CSS

plugins.name: equiTweaks
plugins.summary: Grab-bag of Discord tweaks: camera mirroring, activity section, soundpack, gateway JSON, onboarding, badges, typing and more.
plugins.bounds: mix of message hooks, camera mirroring, modal CSS, soundpack, gateway JSON, safety-hub fetch, typing POST; few prefs map to local_settings/notification_settings
plugins.target: none as bundle; split prefs to local/notification settings

plugins.name: equibopStreamFixes.equibop
plugins.summary: Patches Discord/Equibop stream encoder quality, bitrate caps, resolution/FPS restrictions and keyframe interval.
plugins.bounds: Discord/Equibop WebRTC encoder constants, bitrate caps, localStorage quality; Serein owns voice pipeline

plugins.name: equicordHelper
plugins.summary: Required Equicord support plugin: crash fixes, plugin support cards/buttons and support-channel alerts.
plugins.bounds: Equicord support cards/buttons, Discord crash patches, support-channel alert; no Discord internals/Equicord services

plugins.name: equicordToolbox
plugins.summary: Header-bar popout button housing Equicord quick actions and a plugin menu.
plugins.bounds: navigation/panel actions approximate quick actions; Serein already has Extensions panel; no header popout/plugin list
plugins.target: Extensions panel (already native), optional nav actions

plugins.name: equissant
plugins.summary: Plays a croissant sound every configured number of clicks using a remote MP3 and a global document click listener.
plugins.bounds: global document click counter + remote MP3 playback; no global input hook, arbitrary audio, or network

plugins.name: exitSounds
plugins.summary: Plays a chosen server soundboard sound when the user disconnects from voice by POSTing SEND_SOUNDBOARD_SOUND on disconnect.
plugins.bounds: sound-catalog selection, voice-disconnect hook, SEND_SOUNDBOARD_SOUND POST; voice_control=mute/deafen/leave/watch only

plugins.name: exportMessages
plugins.summary: B (bounded native capability): exports one message as text and optionally copies friend/blocked/request usernames. Safe subset is selected_message text plus clipboard_write; full file export needs a narrow save-file action. Do not expose attachment bytes or arbitrary message lookup.
plugins.bounds: 1 selected message; 4 KiB clipboard; at most 100 relationships; no attachment URLs/bytes; 8 KiB effect proposal

implementation.limitations: One selected message, text only, 4 KiB clipboard copy after Apply; no files, attachments, embeds or contact export.

plugins.name: fastDeleteChannels
plugins.summary: B (bounded native capability): permission-gated channel deletion from the channel row or keybind. Needs channel_control.delete_channel and the host's native MANAGE_CHANNELS and destructive-Apply checks; the upstream one-keypress delete must gain confirmation.
plugins.bounds: 1 loaded channel per Apply; native permission check; destructive confirmation; no background or bulk deletion

implementation.limitations: One current loaded server channel/thread per Apply with native permission recheck and destructive confirmation; no keybind, row icon or bulk deletion.

plugins.name: favoriteAnything
plugins.summary: U: favorites any attachment/embed and writes Discord's favoriteGifs proto, with an external placeholder.nin0.dev thumbnail service. Requires attachment URLs/bytes, media rendering and settings writes that the extension boundary does not grant.
plugins.bounds: No bounded grant: attachment bytes/URLs unavailable; external thumbnail service sees filenames/sizes; no favoriteGifs write

plugins.name: fileUpload
plugins.summary: U: uploads arbitrary user files to configurable third-party hosts (Zipline, Nest, S3, WebDAV, ShareX and others) with API keys, basic auth, S3 secrets and an optional CORS proxy. This is generic file egress and credential handling, outside the boundary.
plugins.bounds: No bounded grant: arbitrary file bytes, user-chosen hosts, credentials and proxy; 300 s timeout

plugins.name: findReply
plugins.summary: S: finds the earliest reply to a message among loaded messages and jumps to it. Maps directly to timeline, message_details reply markers and navigation.jump_to_message; no new host surface.
plugins.bounds: 50 loaded messages; 12 detailed rows when timeline is also granted; 8 KiB effect; loaded window only, no history fetch

implementation.limitations: Loaded reply context only; one Apply-reviewed jump; no history fetch.

plugins.name: fixFileExtensions
plugins.summary: U (native-only): rewrites incompatible upload extensions before send. The SDK intentionally exposes no attachment path, filename, bytes or pre-upload mutation hook, so this belongs in core upload handling, not an extension.
plugins.bounds: No attachment filename/path/bytes grant; native upload pipeline only

plugins.name: followVoiceUser
plugins.summary: B (bounded native capability): follows one friend's voice channel changes and optionally leaves when they leave. Uses voice_state and voice_connect, but must stay explicit-target and per-join Apply; upstream's automatic follow/leave loop must be guarded.
plugins.bounds: At most 64 voice participants; one followed user; per-join Apply/confirmation; loop guard; no background auto-join

plugins.name: fontLoader
plugins.summary: U (native-only): searches Google Fonts over the network, downloads font CSS and applies an arbitrary family to the UI. appearance only accepts declarative colors and control metrics, so a native installed/bundled font picker is the bounded alternative; the network font loader is rejected.
plugins.bounds: No font file or CSS grant; appearance colors/metrics only; no remote font fetch

plugins.name: frequentQuickSwitcher
plugins.summary: U (native-only): rewrites quick-switcher results from Discord frecency data. The SDK exposes navigation/search but no quick-switcher result callback or frecency store, so this needs a native search-results hook.
plugins.bounds: No quick-switcher result injection or frecency access; upstream caps results at 20

plugins.name: friendCodes
plugins.summary: B (bounded native capability): lists, creates and revokes friend invite codes from the Friends header. Needs a narrow friend-invite action with explicit Apply; codes are sensitive and must not be auto-created or auto-revoked.
plugins.bounds: One invite operation per Apply; enforce account max age/uses; no automatic create/revoke; panel-local list

plugins.name: friendTags
plugins.summary: U (native-only): stores local user tags and filters quick-switcher results by &tag. storage plus relationships can hold a bounded tag manager, but the core quick-switcher filter hook does not exist; only a native hook would make the workflow possible.
plugins.bounds: 1 MiB storage and 100 relationships are feasible, but no quick-switcher filter/result injection

plugins.name: friendshipRanks
plugins.summary: U (native-only): derives friendship-duration badges from friend-since timestamps and renders them on profiles/messages. relationships exposes friend kind but not friend-since, and there is no profile-badge rendering API.
plugins.bounds: No friend-since field; no badge API; seven rank thresholds from 0 to 1,826.25 days

plugins.name: fullVcPfp
plugins.summary: U (native-only): renders a participant's full-resolution avatar as the voice tile background. voice_state provides participant IDs, not tile rendering, and appearance cannot draw arbitrary voice tiles.
plugins.bounds: No voice-tile render or arbitrary drawing grant; avatar URL resolution only

plugins.name: ghosted
plugins.summary: U (native-only): tracks DMs whose last message is from the other person and shows a ghost counter/modal. read_state covers the selected conversation only; there is no background per-DM last-message scan or DM-list badge render hook.
plugins.bounds: Selected conversation only; no background DM enumeration; in-memory channel set upstream

plugins.name: gifCollections
plugins.summary: U (native-only): saves GIF collections into the expression picker and refreshes signed CDN URLs. data_queries.request_gifs returns bounded results, but there is no picker-row injection or arbitrary GIF-URL send path.
plugins.bounds: No picker injection or arbitrary URL send; a native store would need item/byte caps and URL-refresh limits

plugins.name: gifMaker
plugins.summary: U (native-only): decodes chat/GIF-picker media, composites captions, encodes a GIF and exports or sends it. Requires media bytes/URLs, frame decoding, file save/send and font loading, none of which are extension grants.
plugins.bounds: 1024x1024 max; 200 frames max; peak frame memory can reach hundreds of MiB; no media/file/font grant

plugins.name: githubRepos
plugins.summary: U: displays a connected GitHub account's public repositories and orgs in profiles via api.github.com. Needs external HTTP and identity lookup; org fan-out is unbounded and the extension boundary provides no network client.
plugins.bounds: Unbounded org fan-out; no HTTP client; public GitHub data only; would need explicit cache/rate limits if native

plugins.name: globalBadges
plugins.summary: U: polls a third-party badge API every 30 minutes and renders remote badge images keyed by Discord user IDs. This is third-party identity enrichment plus network and remote assets, outside the boundary.
plugins.bounds: 30-minute poll; remote badge API/images; user-ID-keyed identity enrichment

plugins.name: googleThat
plugins.summary: S: builds a search-engine URL from a query and proposes it as a message. Uses message_send only; the plugin performs no network request and does not open the browser.
plugins.bounds: 2,000 characters / 8 KiB message content; Apply required; selected accessible channel

implementation.limitations: Fixed Google reviewed browser URL; no sent search message or custom engines.

plugins.name: guildPickerDumper
plugins.summary: U (native-only): bulk-downloads a server's emojis and stickers from the media proxy and ZIPs them locally. guild_directory exposes names/IDs/icons only, and there is no emoji catalog, CDN byte or file-save grant.
plugins.bounds: No emoji/sticker/file access; guild_directory caps at 100 names/IDs/icons; native export needs asset-count and archive-byte caps

plugins.name: hideChatButtons
plugins.summary: U (native-only): wraps and hides chat-bar buttons with a toggle. appearance cannot change control visibility or inject chat-bar components, so this is a native UI preference.
plugins.bounds: No control-visibility or chat-bar injection grant; appearance colors/metrics only

plugins.name: hideMessages
plugins.summary: U (native-only): hides messages and DMs until restart by filtering timeline rows and the private-channel list. The SDK has no timeline or DM-list filtering hook.
plugins.bounds: No timeline/DM-list filter hook; session-local hidden-ID set only

plugins.name: hideServers
plugins.summary: U (native-only): hides guilds/folders from the server list and quick switcher using a local hidden-ID store. guild_directory is read-only and capped; there is no guild-list or quick-switcher filter injection.
plugins.bounds: guild_directory read-only at 100 names/IDs/icons; local hidden set; no list/quick-switcher filtering

plugins.name: homeTyping
plugins.summary: U (native-only): replaces the Home button with a typing indicator when any DM is typing. conversation_activity covers the selected conversation only and there is no Home-button render hook.
plugins.bounds: Selected-conversation typing only; no all-DM typing aggregation; no Home-button render

plugins.name: hopOn
plugins.summary: B (bounded native capability): watches the active conversation for a configured regex and opens a URL. message_events supplies bounded text and external_navigation can propose an HTTPS URL, but every open needs Apply; automatic launch is not possible and the default custom launcher scheme is unsupported.
plugins.bounds: 16 KiB message-event text; 2,048-byte HTTPS URL only; per-open Apply; no auto launch

implementation.limitations: Up to eight case-insensitive literal triggers and one public HTTPS link; manual selected-message check and Apply-reviewed open. No regex, custom launcher, automatic events or launch.

plugins.name: husk
plugins.summary: S: adds a context action that ensures the configured custom emoji reaction is present on a message. Uses reactions_control.set_reaction only; no network or account-wide state.
plugins.bounds: One loaded message; emoji name:id at most 128 UTF-8 bytes; existing reaction state respected

implementation.limitations: One default Husk desired-set reaction after Apply; no same-server emoji lookup.

plugins.name: iRememberYou
plugins.summary: U: builds an unbounded local archive of users, guild owners and guild members from mentions, replies and member lists. This is a raw user/identity store; storage is 1 MiB and relationship/member snapshots cap at 100, so it is not a safe extension port.
plugins.bounds: Storage 1 MiB; relationships/members at most 100 rows; per-owned-guild member cap 1,000 upstream; raw archive excluded

plugins.name: iconViewer
plugins.summary: S (native dev tool): browses host icon modules, previews colors/sizes and saves icon files locally. Reads no account data and makes no network request; it is safe as a native developer surface, not as a general extension.
plugins.bounds: Host icon modules only; lazy render batches of 120; no account data, persistence or network

plugins.name: idleAutoRestart
plugins.summary: U (native-only): restarts the client after a configurable idle period unless in voice. Requires a background timer, activity listeners and app restart control, none of which extensions have.
plugins.bounds: No background timers or commands; native idle setting only; 5-120 minute range

plugins.name: ignoreCalls
plugins.summary: B (bounded native capability): suppresses ringing from ignored users/group DMs. voice_state and voice_connect can decline a current call, but the ignore list must be local and each decline must go through Apply; upstream's automatic CALL_UPDATE rewrite is not available.
plugins.bounds: At most 64 voice participants; one current call per Apply; local ignore list; no background auto-decline

implementation.limitations: At most 16 local DM/group-DM IDs and one explicit Apply-reviewed decline. No automatic ringing suppression or CALL_UPDATE rewriting.

plugins.name: inRole
plugins.summary: Role and message context menus plus a local /inrole command show members of a role. Safe now using loaded member/role data only; do not enable Developer Mode like upstream.
plugins.bounds: Loaded/cached members only (about 100 default), no REST fetch; existing paged Server Settings role-member search may backfill. Cap modal rows and label loaded-only limitation.
plugins.target: crates/ui/src/server_roles.rs role-member directory and context menus

implementation.limitations: Loaded-role/member subset only; no guild-wide endpoint/fetch.

plugins.name: ingtoninator
plugins.summary: Appends a case-preserving ington suffix to a randomly selected legal Unicode word outside URL ranges; an Apply-reviewed composer action can port this locally.
plugins.bounds: Composer draft 2,000 chars/8,000 bytes; Unicode word scan with URL/code/token protection; explicit Apply, no automatic send or network.

implementation.limitations: Deterministic eligible-word selection instead of upstream random selection; one Apply-reviewed draft change outside protected URL/code/token spans; no pre-send hook.

plugins.name: instantScreenshare
plugins.summary: Auto-starts screen capture on voice join, with optional camera devices and auto mute/deafen. Native capture exists but Serein requires an explicit Share action.
plugins.bounds: If redesigned: one stream, remembered source, explicit keybind/picker confirmation, screen-recording permission. Auto start-on-join is not acceptable.

plugins.name: invisibleChat.desktop
plugins.summary: Zero-width/StegCloak hidden-payload messages with cover text, local embed mutation and external unfurl. Complex JS dependency and hidden-content tooling; low safety/value fit.
plugins.bounds: A reveal-only local codec could be bounded, but no hidden-payload sending or third-party unfurl in the native client.

plugins.name: inviteDefaults
plugins.summary: Persists default invite expiry, use count and temporary membership for the existing invite dialog. Exact safe-now match to Serein InviteOptions.
plugins.bounds: Existing values only: max_age 1800..604800 or 0, max_uses 0..100, temporary boolean. No new grant or protocol.

implementation.limitations: Saved expiry, use-count and temporary-membership defaults with existing 30-day/100-use validation; server permissions and service limits still apply.

plugins.name: jumpTo
plugins.summary: Channel, thread, user and message context-menu actions jump to the first/last channel message or a user's first/last message in the channel.
plugins.bounds: First/last uses one GET messages limit=1; user jump uses existing from:/in: search asc/desc with one page. Permission-checked, no paging loop.

implementation.limitations: Latest/oldest only within loaded channel details and the 50-row window after Apply. No true first-message read, search fetch or native context-menu registration.

plugins.name: keyboardNavigation
plugins.summary: Keybind-opened command palette for navigation and app actions. Native palette is feasible with an allowlisted action set.
plugins.bounds: Reuse keybind capture; native navigation/settings only. Exclude arbitrary URL fetch, relaunch, folder open and plugin toggling or require normal confirmation. Bound action/result count and ignore while text input/IME is focused.
plugins.target: crates/ui/src/keybinds.rs and a native command-palette modal

plugins.name: keyboardSounds
plugins.summary: Plays local OperaGX/osu-style key sounds. Feasible with bundled audio packs and a dedicated non-call SFX channel.
plugins.bounds: Bundle assets, no network download; at most 3 concurrent voices per category, user volume; observe key codes only, no text logging; disable while muted.

plugins.name: keywordNotify
plugins.summary: Notifies when message or embed text matches configured regex entries, with whitelist/blacklist and a small hit log.
plugins.bounds: At most 32 entries, pattern 256 bytes with compile budget, message/embed text only, in-memory log of 50. Do not inject synthetic mentions like upstream; use normal notification UI.

implementation.limitations: At most 32 literal, case-insensitive keywords with 16 allow and 16 deny guild/channel IDs and a transient 50-match bound; no regex or fabricated mentions.

plugins.name: lastActive
plugins.summary: Context menus jump to the current user's or another user's last message in a channel or server via the existing search route.
plugins.bounds: Search author_id plus channel_id, sort desc, one page, permission-gated. Duplicates jumpTo user search; consider merging.

implementation.limitations: Current/selected author earliest/latest message only within the loaded conversation window. No guild-wide or unloaded-history author search.

plugins.name: limitlessScreenshare
plugins.summary: Adds resolution and FPS sliders/presets to screen-share settings instead of fixed presets.
plugins.bounds: Clamp to capture backend offered resolutions/frame rates and encoder/remote-decode limits; practical exemplar 3-1440p and 1-120 fps but validate each mode. No subscription fields.

plugins.name: loginWithQR
plugins.summary: Scans a login QR image or pasted token and uses remote-auth handshake/finish/cancel to authorize another device. New credential/authentication path.
plugins.bounds: Serein auth is hosted webview or owner-pasted token; QR remote-auth handoff is explicitly unverified/high-risk. Only revisit under a separate reviewed auth design.
plugins.target: authentication flow; not the ordinary client UI

plugins.name: markdownTables
plugins.summary: Renders GitHub-style markdown tables in messages with alignment and horizontal scrolling.
plugins.bounds: Use existing bounded parser budget; cap about 20 columns, 100 rows, 32 KiB table; overflow falls back to literal text. Inline formatting in cells, no images autoload.

plugins.name: mediaPlaybackSpeed
plugins.summary: Adds playback-rate controls and per-media-type defaults for inline audio, video and voice messages.
plugins.bounds: Add rate to AudioCommand/VideoCommand; menu range 0.25-3.5x, per-item plus default preferences. No protocol change; pitch preservation is not guaranteed.
plugins.target: crates/ui/src/audio.rs, crates/ui/src/video.rs and desktop playback backend

implementation.limitations: Native 0.25x-3.5x controls for each inline audio/video session; PCM-rate/clock based and not pitch-preserving; no persisted per-media-type defaults.

plugins.name: messageBurst
plugins.summary: Merges a new outbound message into the user's immediately previous message when nobody else has spoken.
plugins.bounds: Only own last message, no pending reply, attachments opt-in, 1-60 second window, merged-content cap. Editing failure must preserve the new content rather than lose it.
plugins.target: crates/ui compose/send path and message edit action

implementation.limitations: Review-only dispersion plus Apply-reviewed editing of the latest loaded ordinary own message with bounded merged content, attachment opt-in and space/newline choice. No automatic send hook, time window, reply-bar check, draft clearing or automatic send.

plugins.name: messageColors
plugins.summary: Detects hex, rgb/rgba and hsl color codes in message text and renders foreground, background or swatch styles.
plugins.bounds: Message body only, token about 64 bytes, reject inside links/code and edits; parse and clamp styles; no images or network.

plugins.name: messageFetchTimer
plugins.summary: Measures and displays how long message history took to load for the selected channel.
plugins.bounds: One timing per channel selection, bounded map about 100 channels; display ms/s plus age. No protocol or cache change.
plugins.target: crates/ui timeline status and client-core load events

plugins.name: messageLinkTooltip
plugins.summary: Shows a hover preview for message links, replies and forwarded-message references.
plugins.bounds: Permission-check target channel, fetch exactly one referenced message, cache about 32 previews or 1 MiB; only explicit hover/focus, no media autoplay or byte prefetch.
plugins.target: crates/ui/src/timeline.rs hover card and bounded message read

plugins.name: messageLoggerEnhanced
plugins.summary: Persistent local log of deleted/edited/ghost-pinged messages, attachment cache, context menu, log UI and export/import.
plugins.bounds: Explicit opt-in per account; whitelist by guild/channel/user; 200-message default, attachments off by default and capped at 12 MiB with extension allowlist; retention and Clear; no background or network. Upstream all-DM defaults are unsuitable.
plugins.target: crates/local-store SQLite, timeline context menu and a logs UI

implementation.limitations: Only subsequently loaded authorized content; bounded native retention, supported attachment downloads and text/JSON export. No import, deleted-before-load recovery, arbitrary downloads or upstream store/DOM parity.

plugins.name: messageNotifier
plugins.summary: Shows a notification when chosen users send messages elsewhere, with click-to-jump navigation.
plugins.bounds: Watchlist at most 64 user IDs; title/body without message content; honor DND/mute and skip selected channel; click navigates to exact message.

implementation.limitations: Bounded 64-author watchlist with normal selected/read/mute/DND/block filters and native channel navigation; no exact missing-message recovery.

plugins.name: messagePeek
plugins.summary: Adds last-message preview text and relative timestamp to direct-message rows.
plugins.bounds: Fetch only visible DMs missing a last message: at most 25, batches of 5, 3 seconds apart, cache about 5 minutes; skip muted/hidden DMs. Preview text at most 256 bytes, media label/icon only, never media bytes.
plugins.target: crates/ui DM row and bounded history reader

plugins.name: messageTranslate
plugins.summary: Auto-translates every message through Google Translate with per-channel toggles. Sends message bodies to a third party and has unbounded in-memory caches.
plugins.bounds: Serein's current translate path is an explicit external-link confirmation. A manual per-message action with one-time third-party consent and bounded LRU could be a separate bounded capability.
plugins.target: message action plus explicit external translation consent

plugins.name: micLoopbackTester
plugins.summary: Account-panel button plays the microphone back locally to test it, auto-deafening while active.
plugins.bounds: Local loopback only, one device, auto-deafen, stop on leave/logout; never route loopback into the Discord call. Keep outside call audio callbacks.
plugins.target: crates/discord-voice audio engine and account panel

plugins.name: middleClickTweaks
plugins.summary: Suppresses middle-click link/media opening and middle-click paste for a short configurable period.
plugins.bounds: Native pointer/clipboard policy only; threshold 1-1000 ms; scope links/media, preserve text-field and normal paste behavior.
plugins.target: crates/ui pointer input and clipboard policy

plugins.name: moreCommands
plugins.summary: Adds many local slash commands plus external animal/neko/GIF endpoints, image-to-GIF conversion and system info.
plugins.bounds: Local commands are safe now. External media endpoints need host allowlist plus consent; omit systeminfo (device fingerprint); keep image/GIF generation local and bounded. One command submission at a time.

implementation.limitations: Deterministic explicit composer subset includes mock, reverse, Morse encode/auto-detect decode, wordcount, upper, lower, repeat 1-10 and uwuify. No external/system/image/GIF, random-response, multi-message, mention/slap or Unicode-normalize commands.

plugins.name: moreStickers.desktop
plugins.summary: Adds third-party sticker packs (LINE), dynamic remote packs, FFmpeg conversion and upload-as-attachment sending.
plugins.bounds: Native-safe form is user-supplied local pack import only: validate 160x160 PNG/GIF, bound pack count and bytes, no scraping, bundled FFmpeg or attachment-upload workaround.
plugins.target: crates/ui sticker picker and local extension storage

plugins.name: moreUserTags
plugins.summary: Shows owner, admin, staff, moderator, VC/chat moderator and webhook tags in chat and member lists.
plugins.bounds: Compute from already-loaded guild/role/permission data for visible users only; no fetch. Per-tag show/hide settings; cap tag text length.
plugins.target: crates/ui timeline/member list and crates/client-core permissions

plugins.name: moyai
plugins.summary: Plays a short moyai sound when the emoji is sent, reacted with, or used as a voice effect in the selected channel.
plugins.bounds: Bundle audio, no GitHub asset fetch; at most 10 plays per message, 300 ms spacing, respect focus, blocked users and bots, user volume.
plugins.target: crates/ui audio SFX and message/reaction events

plugins.name: musicControls
plugins.summary: Spotify and Tidal playback controls plus lyrics. Upstream controls Spotify using Discord's linked-account access token, uses a local Tidal WebSocket bridge and calls third-party lyric/translate services.
plugins.bounds: Credential extraction and third-party egress conflict with Serein boundaries. A native OAuth playback-control and explicit lyric-download design would be a separate bounded capability.
plugins.target: new native account-integration design, not the ordinary client

plugins.name: neverPausePreviews
plugins.summary: Forces call/PiP stream previews to keep running when the client is unfocused. Serein intentionally pauses inline GIF/video when unfocused and has no equivalent paused PiP/stream preview.
plugins.bounds: Forcing decode while unfocused contradicts the bounded media policy. If needed, add an explicit keep-active-watch-playing option with a decode/network bound instead.

plugins.name: newPluginsManager
plugins.summary: Shows a modal of newly added plugins/settings, reads the plugin registry and DataStore known-settings, and can enable plugins with a client reload.
plugins.bounds: Local plugin registry/settings only; require explicit confirmation before enabling a plugin or reloading; no network.

plugins.name: noNitroUpsell
plugins.summary: Hides Nitro upsells by setting premiumTypeOverride=2, making the client believe the account has Nitro.
plugins.bounds: Port as pure upsell-UI suppression only; do not mirror a fake premium entitlement into client state; server remains authoritative.

plugins.name: noPushToTalk
plugins.summary: Patches USE_VAD permission checks, the warning indicator, and canUseVoiceActivity() to true, bypassing channels that enforce push-to-talk.
plugins.bounds: Server-enforced voice permission bypass; must not be reimplemented around the permission boundary.

plugins.name: noRPC.discordDesktop
plugins.summary: Disables Discord's local RPC server by removing the discord_rpc module load.
plugins.bounds: Privacy-positive native setting; disable locally without touching remote account state.

plugins.name: noRoleHeaders
plugins.summary: Removes role group headers from the member list by returning null for unknown-role header rows.
plugins.bounds: Render suppression only; no data access beyond the member-list row already rendered.

implementation.limitations: Only unresolved pseudo-role member headers after roles load; real roles and online/offline headers remain visible.

plugins.name: normalizeMessageLinks
plugins.summary: Rewrites copied message-link hosts from canary.discord.com/ptb.discord.com to discord.com.
plugins.bounds: Local string transform in the message-copy path only; no storage or network.

implementation.limitations: Selected-message exact canary/ptb HTTPS authorities rewritten to discord.com and copied after Apply; no redirect/fetch.

plugins.name: notificationTitle.discordDesktop
plugins.summary: Rewrites desktop notification titles to include author, reply context, channel/thread, and guild names; reads channel, guild, user, and relationship stores.
plugins.bounds: Local notification formatting only; no additional retention or network.

implementation.limitations: Notification titles include loaded reply, channel/thread and guild context within the existing 200-byte title bound; unavailable names are not invented.

plugins.name: orbolayBridge
plugins.summary: Connects to a localhost WebSocket at 127.0.0.1:6888 and sends voice rosters, display names/avatars, soundboard data, streamer mode, and notification title/body; accepts mute, deafen, disconnect, stop-stream, and navigate commands.
plugins.bounds: Localhost-only explicit opt-in; no auto-connect; redact notification content; restrict accepted remote commands to the documented bounded set.

plugins.name: partyMode
plugins.summary: Enables and tunes Discord's built-in POGGERMODE screen-shake/confetti effects via local Flux dispatches.
plugins.bounds: Cosmetic local state only; no account or network mutation.

plugins.name: pendingFriendRequest
plugins.summary: Adds buttons and context-menu actions to cancel the current user's own outgoing friend request using RelationshipActions.cancelFriendRequest.
plugins.bounds: Only outgoing requests for the current user; reuse the existing relationship endpoint; no new grants.

implementation.limitations: One current loaded outgoing request only, one Apply-reviewed cancellation, kind/id revalidated; no incoming request actions.

plugins.name: pinIcon
plugins.summary: Renders a pin badge on pinned messages.
plugins.bounds: Render-only indicator using the already-loaded message.pinned flag.

implementation.limitations: Pin badge only from known native pin state; no fetching or inferred pinned state.

plugins.name: pingNotifications
plugins.summary: Observes MESSAGE_CREATE and emits local OS notifications with formatted mentions; reads message content, author, mentions, presence, relationship, and guild/channel mute state.
plugins.bounds: Local notifications only; honor mute/block/DND filters; keep body preview bounded (already 200 chars); no message retention.

plugins.name: polishWording
plugins.summary: Rewrites outgoing message text for apostrophes, capitalization, punctuation, and contraction expansion while preserving inline/fenced code blocks.
plugins.bounds: Outgoing text only, user-configurable, local processing; no storage or network.

implementation.limitations: Deterministic bounded prose transforms with protected spans; no automatic outgoing mutation.

plugins.name: profileSets
plugins.summary: Captures and applies profile presets including avatar/banner, bio, pronouns, theme colors, and custom status; stores base64 profile images and profile fields in DataStore and applies them through Discord's pending-profile-change UI.
plugins.bounds: Sensitive profile bundle: encrypt at rest, bound preset count and image bytes, require explicit user apply; never auto-submit profile changes.

implementation.limitations: Up to 16 display-name/bio/pronouns presets with explicit save/apply/delete. No images, colors, guild profiles, import/export, image storage or automatic submission.

plugins.name: questify
plugins.summary: Enhances the Quest UI and can auto-enroll/auto-complete quests by spoofing video progress and heartbeats, using OAuth grants/proxy tickets/auth codes, and opening DevTools.
plugins.bounds: Reward/ToS fraud and token-boundary abuse; do not port or emulate fabricated quest completion.

plugins.name: quickThemeSwitcher.discordDesktop
plugins.summary: Enumerates local and online themes, cycles/enables them via Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Arrow hotkeys, and writes theme settings.
plugins.bounds: Read theme filenames and write theme selection settings only; no arbitrary file access.

plugins.name: quoter
plugins.summary: Renders a message and avatar into a quote image on a canvas, imports Google Fonts, and exports or uploads the result on user action.
plugins.bounds: User-initiated only; outbound Discord CDN/Google Fonts fetches; do not persist message content beyond the open modal.

plugins.name: randomVoice
plugins.summary: Chooses a random joinable voice channel and joins it, optionally applying mute/deafen/camera/stream and leaving empty channels.
plugins.bounds: Explicit user action or configured keybind; enforce CONNECT/STREAM permissions; no silent auto-join or unrequested media activation.

implementation.limitations: Deterministic rotation over loaded voice/stage channels with Apply-reviewed join, muted by default. Not random; no auto-join, keybind, leave-empty, friend/AFK filters, camera or stream.

plugins.name: reactionTimestamps
plugins.summary: Records reaction add/remove timestamps in a 2000-entry in-memory map and displays them in the reaction popout.
plugins.bounds: Bounded RAM (2000 entries), local memory only, cleared on stop.

plugins.name: recentDMSwitcher
plugins.summary: Implements Ctrl+Tab MRU switching across DMs and group DMs, persists DM channel IDs, and shows an overlay or toast while cycling.
plugins.bounds: Local DM-ID history, bounded by configured count; no message content stored; clearable by the user.

implementation.limitations: At most 20 DM/group-DM IDs and manual previous-loaded-DM navigation/clear. No hotkey, overlay, toast, avatars, message content or automatic navigation.

plugins.name: remix
plugins.summary: Opens a canvas image editor for an attachment or media URL and uploads the remixed PNG through the normal upload prompt.
plugins.bounds: User-initiated; fetches Discord CDN media; no background processing or extra storage.

plugins.name: repeatMessages
plugins.summary: Resends a message's content, attachment URLs, and sticker IDs, optionally as a reply when Shift is held; uses allowedMentions parse=[].
plugins.bounds: Explicit user action; no mention fanout; reuses the normal send path.

implementation.limitations: Apply-reviewed repeat send or explicit reply with user/role/everyone/here neutralization and reply mention disabled. No attachments, stickers, alternate channel or retry.

plugins.name: replyPingControl
plugins.summary: Adjusts message.mentions locally on receive to always, never, or per-user control reply pings, with whitelist/blacklist.
plugins.bounds: Local notification state only; does not alter the server message or mentions for other users.

plugins.name: richMagnetLinks
plugins.summary: Renders magnet links in messages with a parsed display filename, similar to message links.
plugins.bounds: Link renderer only; no network request or automatic download.

implementation.limitations: Magnet parsing/copying only; no inline link rendering, tokenizer patch or automatic open/download.

plugins.name: richPresence
plugins.summary: Polls AudioBookShelf, Jellyfin, Navidrome, stats.fm, Gensokyo Radio, and local osu! tosu for now-playing data; stores server URLs plus plaintext ABS/Navidrome passwords, a Jellyfin API key, and optional Last.fm key.
plugins.bounds: Blocked on OS credential-vault integration and in-memory redaction; allowlist user-configured hosts; bound polling payloads/intervals; no credential logging.

plugins.name: rpcEditor
plugins.summary: Rewrites the type, name, details, state, assets, and stream URL of local Rich Presence activities for configured application IDs.
plugins.bounds: Local presence display only; cosmetic field overrides; no token access or server-side spoofing beyond the normal presence path.

plugins.name: saveFavoriteGIFs
plugins.summary: Exports favorited GIF URLs to a text file and can HEAD-check each URL to filter broken entries.
plugins.bounds: Explicit file-save consent; outbound requests only to the user's saved GIF hosts; bound list size and result payload.

plugins.name: scheduledMessages
plugins.summary: Schedules messages (including base64-encoded attachments) for a future time, shows them as phantom messages, and sends them through the normal upload/send path with per-channel minute rate limiting and retries.
plugins.bounds: Persisted queue contains message text and attachment bytes: bound queue length, total bytes, and retention; require explicit scheduling; send only while the client is running; never bypass normal upload/rate limits.

plugins.name: screenRecorder.equibop
plugins.summary: Records the screen with getDisplayMedia (audio and video) via MediaRecorder and uploads the WebM through the normal upload prompt.
plugins.bounds: Explicit screen/mic capture consent; keep capture/encoding outside UI and audio-call callbacks; no background recording.

plugins.name: searchFix
plugins.summary: Adjusts search query sort order and offset when offset exceeds 5000 to avoid Discord's magnifying-glass search error; does not exceed the server's 5000-message window.
plugins.bounds: Client-side search query only; no server cap bypass. Porting should fix the always-true 'offset > 5000 - 5000' condition that resets offset to 0.

plugins.name: sedEnhanced
plugins.summary: Applies s/…/…/ to the pending reply or last own editable message; safe port requires an explicit own-message edit workflow and literal matching by default.
plugins.bounds: Current account own loaded message only; 2,000-char content; explicit confirm; literal global/single replace; any optional regex needs strict pattern size/compute limits.
plugins.target: Native own-message sed editor with no arbitrary regex evaluation or other-author edits.

implementation.limitations: Literal escapes and first/global replacement only on loaded own messages after Apply; no arbitrary regex/modes/pending-reply interception. Empty replacement deletes only when attachments are confirmed empty.

plugins.name: sekaiStickers
plugins.summary: B - Sekai sticker canvas with remote artwork/fonts; uploads composed PNG as an attachment.
plugins.bounds: Remote GETs to st.ayaka.one for character images and raw.githubusercontent.com for two fonts; persistent font load; 296x256 canvas; user explicitly triggers attachment upload.
plugins.target: Native sticker composer with host allowlist for assets, local font fallback, and upload only on explicit confirmation.

plugins.name: serverSearch
plugins.summary: S - Adds a server-list search button that opens the existing quick switcher.
plugins.bounds: No network, storage, or account mutation; single UI button dispatching QUICKSWITCHER_SHOW.
plugins.target: Native server-list search shortcut using existing local navigation.

plugins.name: showBadgesInChat
plugins.summary: B - Shows Discord profile, Nitro, contributor, and donor badges beside message authors.
plugins.bounds: Reads Discord user flags/premium fields and Vencord/Equicord dev lists; GET badge.equicord.org/badges.json plus cdn.discordapp.com icon images; per-badge toggles and ordering; bounded to rendered authors.
plugins.target: Native badge row from already-loaded profile flags with a local contributor list and cached CDN icons; avoid a runtime third-party donor lookup unless cached/consented.

plugins.name: showMessageEmbeds
plugins.summary: B - Context-menu action to show or remove embeds for links/attachments via Discord's unfurl API.
plugins.bounds: URL is normalized then sent to Discord's own unfurl endpoint through RestAPI; no third-party host; requires link present in message text to re-add; UI limited to message/attachment context menus.
plugins.target: Native 'show/remove embed' menu using the already-authenticated Discord REST unfurl call with URL normalization.

plugins.name: showResourceChannels
plugins.summary: S - Reveals channels normally hidden behind server resources in the channel list.
plugins.bounds: Single render patch disabling the hideResourceChannels flag; no network, storage, or account action.
plugins.target: Native channel-list option to display resource channels.

plugins.name: showRolesInChat
plugins.summary: S - Shows a member's highest role icon next to their message name, with per-role hide/show.
plugins.bounds: Reads GuildMemberStore/GuildRoleStore for the current guild; excluded-role list in private settings; bot display toggle; no network or account mutation.
plugins.target: Native highest-role badge with local excluded-role preferences.

implementation.limitations: Loaded-role inspection only; no inline author badge, bot toggle, role color/icon in chat or context-menu toggles.

plugins.name: showSongName
plugins.summary: S - Displays the Spotify song name instead of the artist in activity text.
plugins.bounds: Display-only patch of activity text; no network, storage, or account action.

plugins.name: sidebarChat
plugins.summary: B - Opens a channel or DM in a sidebar or native popout window and can persist/reopen them.
plugins.bounds: Persists channel IDs and popout state in DataStore/settings; native window management with always-on-top option; restores windows on startup; no external network or credential access.
plugins.target: Native per-channel sidebar/popout window surface with explicit persistence toggle and bounded window count.

plugins.name: signature
plugins.summary: S - Appends a user-configured signature block to outgoing messages, with toggle UI and command.
plugins.bounds: Local settings only; transforms outbound content before send; final length constrained by Discord; chat-bar, context-menu, and /signature toggles.
plugins.target: Native compose transform with explicit enable and local signature text.

implementation.limitations: Apply-reviewed idempotent signature; no automatic outgoing mutation.

plugins.name: silenceUsers
plugins.summary: B - Suppresses mention pings and server badge counts from listed user IDs.
plugins.bounds: Comma-separated user ID list in settings; intercepts MESSAGE_CREATE/MESSAGE_UPDATE and cancels NOTIFICATION_CREATE; mutates shared gateway event objects (mention_everyone/roles/mentions); README says DMs untouched though code filters all message creates.
plugins.target: Native local notification filter over an immutable event copy with bounded ID list; never mutate shared gateway payloads.

plugins.name: snowfall
plugins.summary: S - Decorative snowfall overlay on the client body.
plugins.bounds: DOM-only animation; 1-60 flakes/second, 10-50px size, solid/text/image modes, pauses when document hidden or unfocused; no network or storage.
plugins.target: Native optional cosmetic overlay with the same hard particle/time caps.

plugins.name: songLink.desktop
plugins.summary: B - Adds streaming-service buttons under song links using Songlink lookups and can open native app URIs.
plugins.bounds: Native fetch to api.song.link with track URL and user country; opens external URLs or provider native app URIs via openExternal; per-service toggles; no credential use.
plugins.target: Native music-link resolver with explicit external-open confirmation, provider allowlist, and no automatic native-scheme launch.

implementation.limitations: Locally recognizes bounded provider URLs and proposes a Songlink/provider HTTPS page. No Songlink API lookup, metadata/inline cards, native URI launch, slash/bot post or automatic send.

plugins.name: songSpotlight.desktop
plugins.summary: U - Publishes a user's song list to a third-party service and renders it in profile sections/widgets.
plugins.bounds: OAuth identify + applications.commands to dc.songspotlight.nexpid.xyz; access/refresh tokens persisted per user; song/profile data fetched and written to third-party API; 6-song limit; main-process native fetch handlers.
plugins.target: Do not adopt as-is. If desired, implement local-only profile song display with no third-party account or OAuth token storage.

plugins.name: splitLargeMessages
plugins.summary: B - Splits over-limit messages into Discord-sized chunks and sends them sequentially with delay.
plugins.bounds: 2000 chars (4000 with Nitro); 0.5-10s configurable delay; slowmode guard 1-30s and permission bypass; cancels original send; restores unsent chunks to input or clipboard; content-only, no attachments.
plugins.target: Native multi-part compose/send with per-channel rate/slowmode checks, sequence cap, and explicit status on partial failure.

implementation.limitations: Review-only bounded segments, not automatic delayed multi-send.

plugins.name: statusPresets
plugins.summary: B - Saves reusable custom statuses and applies one to the user's Discord custom status.
plugins.bounds: Presets stored in plugin settings (text, emoji, clear-after); writes Discord customStatus user setting; emoji presets require Nitro; status submenu and remember button; no network beyond Discord.
plugins.target: Native saved custom-status presets applied only on explicit selection.

implementation.limitations: Bounded named local presence presets; no custom emoji field or background writes.

plugins.name: statusWhileActive.desktop
plugins.summary: B - Temporarily sets a chosen online status while in a voice channel and restores the prior status on leave.
plugins.bounds: Reads own voice state; writes Discord status setting; restores previous status only if changed; four preset statuses; no extra network, storage, or credentials.
plugins.target: Native voice-presence automation with explicit toggle and reliable restore.

plugins.name: steamStatusSync
plugins.summary: U - Mirrors Discord presence to the local Steam client by opening steam:// status URIs on every status update.
plugins.bounds: Launches external steam://friends/status/<state> on USER_SETTINGS_PROTO_UPDATE; per-status mapping; can force invisible when activity hidden; leaks Discord presence/activity state to another app with no confirmation.
plugins.target: Do not adopt. Any presence bridge would need explicit one-shot consent, debouncing, and a visible external-app disclosure.

plugins.name: stickerBlocker
plugins.summary: S - Replaces blocked stickers with a local placeholder and offers block/unblock menu actions.
plugins.bounds: Blocked sticker ID list in local settings plus DataStore namespace; optional remote blocked.gif from equicord.org; message and expression-picker context menus; no account mutation.
plugins.target: Native sticker render filter using a local ID list and bundled placeholder asset.

plugins.name: stopAutoUnread
