plugins.bounds: New unofficial affinity read; OP 8 guild-member requests chunk at 100 IDs; local relationship overlay only; rate-limited and unverified.

plugins.name: ircColors
plugins.summary: Assign deterministic per-user HSL nickname colours, with seed, lightness and saturation settings, overriding role colours.
plugins.bounds: Hash and settings only; no new data; message and member-list render paths.

plugins.name: jumpToTop
plugins.summary: Add a channel-header button that jumps to the first message in the channel.
plugins.bounds: One bounded history page at the channel start using after=0 (unofficial parameter usage); existing request deadline and window limits.

plugins.name: keepCurrentChannel
plugins.summary: Per-account last DM and per-guild last viewed channel are already remembered and restored after account load or switch.
plugins.bounds: Existing session state and local-store caps.

plugins.name: loadingQuotes
plugins.summary: The native client has no Discord loading-quote carousel to replace.
plugins.bounds: Not applicable.

plugins.name: memberCount
plugins.summary: Member-list group headers already show online and offline counts, and server settings shows total and online counts; only a guild-tooltip and voice count remain.
plugins.bounds: Existing member list and server settings data.

plugins.name: mentionAvatars
plugins.summary: Render small user avatars and role icons inside user and role mentions.
plugins.bounds: 16 px cached avatars and role icons from the existing mention source; no extra network request.

plugins.name: messageClickActions
plugins.summary: Configurable single, double and triple click actions such as edit, reply, delete, quote and react; only double-click reaction exists today.
plugins.bounds: Existing input timing and action allowlist; actions run only on explicit pointer clicks.

plugins.name: messageLatency
plugins.summary: Show an indicator and tooltip when an incoming message's nonce-to-message-ID delay exceeds a threshold.
plugins.bounds: Display-only using Message.nonce and snowflake IDs; configurable threshold; no persistence.

plugins.name: messageLinkEmbeds
plugins.summary: Render an inline preview card for messages that link another Discord message.
plugins.bounds: One permission-checked linked-message read per preview; at most 5 links per message; nesting depth at most 3; LRU cache at most 256 KiB; skip channels the user cannot view.

implementation.limitations: Scans up to five links in selected text, previews only loaded-timeline targets and offers Apply-reviewed navigation. No linked-message fetch, inline accessory, media, cross-channel permission lookup or nesting.

plugins.name: messageLogger
plugins.summary: Keep temporary edit and delete history for loaded messages and expose clear/history actions.
plugins.bounds: Session-only: 8 snapshots of at most 64 KiB each; cleared on logout; deleted retention already exists via the deleted_messages capability.

implementation.limitations: Native bounded persistent history with edit/delete retention, all subsequently loaded readable chats, opt-in supported downloads, ghost alerts and export; no deleted-before-load recovery or upstream JavaScript hooks.

plugins.name: moreQuickReactions
plugins.summary: Make the quick-reaction count configurable beyond the current fixed three, using existing frecency and favourite emoji.
plugins.bounds: Configurable 0-42 quick reactions with bounded rows and columns; hover bar and context menu only.

implementation.limitations: Explicit 0-42 reaction list, 20 loaded-message choices and one Apply-reviewed add. No hover bar, row/column picker UI, scrolling layout or emoji-frecency integration.

plugins.name: musicRichPresence
plugins.summary: Publish Last.fm or ListenBrainz listening activity as rich presence.
plugins.bounds: Polling no faster than 30 seconds; explicit third-party host allowlist; API key in the OS credential store; 4 KiB activity cap.

plugins.name: mutedServersActivityBadge
plugins.summary: Serein renders unread and voice-call badges only; there is no muted-server activity badge to keep visible.
plugins.bounds: Not applicable.

plugins.name: mutualGroupDMs
plugins.summary: Show group DMs shared with a profile user in the profile side panel and DM list.
plugins.bounds: Use cached sorted private channels filtered by recipient; at most 50 rows.

plugins.name: newGuildSettings
plugins.summary: Apply opt-in default notification, mention and channel-visibility settings when joining a server.
plugins.bounds: Opt-in only; one guild-settings PATCH per join; rate-limited; no bulk folder loop.

plugins.name: noBlockedMessages
plugins.summary: Hide blocked and optionally ignored users' messages from the chat stream instead of showing Discord's collapsed blocked group.
plugins.bounds: Local timeline filter over existing blocked/ignored flags; handle blocked groups, thread starters and trailing dividers; notifications are already suppressed.

plugins.name: noDeepLinks.web
plugins.summary: The native client is itself the link handler and has no Discord web-app deep-link modal to disable.
plugins.bounds: Not applicable.

plugins.name: noDevtoolsWarning
plugins.summary: Suppresses Discord devtools warnings and side-effects that hide the account token; Serein deliberately retains token-protection behavior rather than porting it.
plugins.bounds: No console patch or credential/page protection bypass is allowed.
plugins.target: Not ported; retain native credential protection.

plugins.name: noF1
plugins.summary: Removes the Discord F1 help keybind. Serein has no F1 help binding; only the general keybind registry exists.
plugins.bounds: No data, network, storage or privileged operation.

plugins.name: noMaskedUrlPaste
plugins.summary: Stops Discord from converting a selected-text URL paste into a masked link. Serein's composer does not auto-mask pasted URLs.
plugins.bounds: Composer text only; no network, storage or Discord write.

plugins.name: noMiddleClickPaste
plugins.summary: Suppresses Linux primary-selection paste on mouse button 1. Small native input guard if Serein ever enables that behavior.
plugins.bounds: Linux-only pointer filtering; no clipboard read, data capture or network.

plugins.name: noMosaic
plugins.summary: Removes Discord's image mosaic and optionally plays videos inline. Serein renders attachments in its own timeline with native media cards.
plugins.bounds: Local media layout only; no fetch beyond existing attachment loading.

plugins.name: noOnboardingDelay
plugins.summary: Skips Discord's onboarding delay. Serein's onboarding flow has no equivalent artificial delay.
plugins.bounds: Local UI timing only; no data or write.

plugins.name: noPendingCount
plugins.summary: Hides pending friend-request, message-request and premium-offer badge counts while keeping the underlying request state.
plugins.bounds: Loaded counts only; no fetch, no request resolution and no Discord write.

plugins.name: noProfileThemes
plugins.summary: Hides other users' Nitro profile theme colors while keeping the current user's theme.
plugins.bounds: Local display toggle over already-loaded theme colors; no fetch or profile write.

implementation.limitations: Hide other loaded profile themes at paint time while retaining the account theme and profile records.

plugins.name: noReplyMention
plugins.summary: Defaults reply sends to not mention the author, with user/role allow lists and an inverted shift-reply option.
plugins.bounds: Reads loaded channel and member role data; local send preference only. Explicit mention still works.

plugins.name: noServerEmojis
plugins.summary: Filters server emojis from autocomplete, optionally keeping only the current server's emojis.
plugins.bounds: Local filter over already-loaded emoji metadata; unicode emojis unaffected; no fetch or write.

plugins.name: noSystemBadge.discordDesktop
plugins.summary: Disables taskbar, Dock and system-tray unread badges. Serein already exposes an unread-badge notification preference.
plugins.bounds: Local device preference only; no message content leaves the app.
plugins.target: notification settings and native unread badge

plugins.name: noTypingAnimation
plugins.summary: Disables Discord's animated typing dots. Serein uses a static typing badge rather than the upstream dot animation.
plugins.bounds: Local rendering only; no data or write.

plugins.name: noUnblockToJump
plugins.summary: Allows opening a message from a blocked or ignored user without unblocking them.
plugins.bounds: Read-only navigation and block-state check; no unblock write and no new data access.

plugins.name: notificationVolume
plugins.summary: Sets a separate volume for notification and in-app sounds. Serein already stores a notification sound volume separate from call output volume.
plugins.bounds: Local audio preference; no capture, recording or network.

plugins.name: onePingPerDM
plugins.summary: Plays only one notification ping per unread burst in user or group DMs, resetting after the messages are read.
plugins.bounds: Bounded per-DM in-memory state; reads loaded message, mention and read-state data; no Discord notification-setting write.

implementation.limitations: One alert per DM unread run with 256-channel volatile state, reset by opening/reading and no unread-count changes.

plugins.name: openInApp
plugins.summary: Opens Spotify, Steam, Epic, Tidal, Apple Music, VRCX and Telegram links in their native apps instead of the browser.
plugins.bounds: Requires a new custom-URI launch capability with an exact scheme and host allowlist, at most 2 KiB URL, explicit confirmation, and no arbitrary protocol launch. Upstream redirect resolution must be omitted or limited to allowlisted public hosts with per-hop validation.

plugins.name: overrideForumDefaults
plugins.summary: Sets the default forum layout and sort order while retaining per-channel overrides.
plugins.bounds: Local view preference only; no server settings write, fetch or storage beyond the preference.

plugins.name: pauseInvitesForever
plugins.summary: Adds an option to pause server invites indefinitely by setting the INVITES_DISABLED guild feature.
plugins.bounds: Requires server-control authority, a manage-permission check, an explicit danger confirmation, one PATCH request and no retries. The guild feature is an unofficial/undocumented behavior.

plugins.name: permissionFreeWill
plugins.summary: Removes client-side lockout and onboarding warnings when editing channel permissions.
plugins.bounds: Server permissions are still enforced; this only suppresses native guardrails. Requires an explicit warning and confirmation because it can lock administrators out of channels. Not an authentication or permission bypass.

plugins.name: permissionsViewer
plugins.summary: Shows a member's, channel's or server's effective permissions and role ordering in a read-only popout.
plugins.bounds: Reads already-loaded roles, members, overwrites and permission decisions; no fetch or write. Cap displayed roles and members and bound panel output.

implementation.limitations: Read-only current-account channel decisions and one loaded member role order. No permission masks, other-member effective permissions, overwrite tables, fetches, context menus, copy-ID or edits.

plugins.name: petpet
plugins.summary: Creates a petpet GIF from an uploaded image, URL or user avatar and offers it as a channel upload.
plugins.bounds: Requires user invocation, a public-IP-pinned HTTPS image downloader, size/time limits, bounded resolution and frame count, and no automatic send. Runtime frames from the upstream VenPlugs repository need license verification or vendoring with pinned bytes.
plugins.target: media worker and attachment upload prompt

plugins.name: pictureInPicture
plugins.summary: Adds an OS picture-in-picture button for video attachments and clips.
plugins.bounds: Requires a new native media-window capability limited to one video surface, no capture or recording, explicit user action, and graceful fallback where the platform PiP API is unavailable.
plugins.target: native video player and window surface

plugins.name: pinDms
plugins.summary: Pins DMs and group DMs above the DM list. Serein already provides device-local pinned DM shortcuts; the upstream category and custom-order layers are not yet present.
plugins.bounds: Local channel IDs and ordering only; existing limits are 256 entries and about 8 KiB of preference JSON.
plugins.target: DM shortcut list and channel preferences

plugins.name: plainFolderIcon
plugins.summary: Hides the small guild icons inside server folder tiles and keeps a plain folder icon.
plugins.bounds: Local folder tile rendering only; no data or write.

plugins.name: platformIndicators
plugins.summary: Shows desktop, mobile, web and VR indicators for users from loaded presence.
plugins.bounds: Read-only presence flags; no new fetch. Serein currently retains per-platform booleans rather than per-platform status strings, so icons can share the overall status color.

implementation.limitations: Cached ClientPlatforms booleans only, no per-platform status inference or probing.

plugins.name: previewMessage
plugins.summary: Previews the current draft and pending attachments locally before sending.
plugins.bounds: Reads the draft and local attachments only; no send or upload. Bound preview text and attachment count, and release local preview resources.

implementation.limitations: Local plain-text draft, staged attachment names/sizes and sticker preview with bounded scrolling. No full Markdown/embed fidelity, upload, send or synthetic timeline message.

plugins.name: quickMention
plugins.summary: Adds a message action that inserts a mention of the author into the composer.
plugins.bounds: Checks send permission and inserts local composer text; no send and no extra data access.

implementation.limitations: Native message-menu mention insertion with compose permission checks; it only edits the draft and never sends automatically.

plugins.name: quickReply
plugins.summary: Uses Ctrl+Up/Down to reply to previous messages and Ctrl+Shift+Up/Down to edit your own messages.
plugins.bounds: Local keybind navigation over loaded messages; checks send permission and honors blocked/ignored filters; opening a reply or edit does not send anything.

implementation.limitations: Optional, unassigned-by-default previous/next reply and own-message edit navigation over loaded, supported non-ephemeral messages; blocked/ignored authors are skipped.

plugins.name: reactErrorDecoder
plugins.summary: Replaces minified React error text by fetching React's error-code catalog at startup. Serein has no React runtime or minified React errors.
plugins.bounds: Not applicable to the native client; a port would add a pointless outbound GitHub request and no user-facing benefit.

plugins.name: readAllNotificationsButton
plugins.summary: Bulk acknowledgement of every unread guild and joined-thread channel is already implemented natively; do not reimplement.
plugins.bounds: Native MAX_BULK_ACK = 1024 channels per chunk with continuation until drained; no new protocol calls or extra data.

plugins.name: relationshipNotifier
plugins.summary: Snapshot loaded friends, incoming requests, group DMs and guilds, then notify locally when a relationship, guild or group is removed.
plugins.bounds: Local gateway events already emitted; snapshot limited to already-loaded state (MAX_NAV) with names and icon ids only; notifications capped by the existing 32-item / 16 KiB budget.
plugins.target: discord-gateway RELATIONSHIP_REMOVE / CHANNEL_DELETE / GUILD_DELETE -> client-core notifications

plugins.name: replaceGoogleSearch
plugins.summary: Context-menu external web search of selected text; native conversation search already covers in-client search, so porting is not recommended.
plugins.bounds: Fixed engine allowlist only, one https URL per click through the existing external-link confirmation; no custom URL and no in-app fetch.

implementation.limitations: Reviewed provider-allowlisted browser search URL.

plugins.name: replyTimestamp
plugins.summary: Show the referenced message timestamp inside reply previews using the already-resolved message.
plugins.bounds: Referenced message already in the bounded timeline (500 messages / 4 MiB); local date formatting only, compact same-day variant.

implementation.limitations: Loaded reply preview timestamp using local time; no linked-message fetch.

plugins.name: revealAllSpoilers
plugins.summary: Ctrl+click reveals spoilers in one message; Ctrl+Shift+click reveals spoilers in the visible chat window.
plugins.bounds: Operates only on content already in loaded messages; scoped to one message or the visible window; no protocol change or fetch.

implementation.limitations: Ctrl-click reveals a message; Ctrl+Shift reveals loaded visible text spoilers. Media spoiler controls stay separate.

plugins.name: reverseImageSearch
plugins.summary: Opens an image in third-party reverse-image engines (Google Lens, Yandex, SauceNAO, IQDB, Bing, TinEye, ImgOps).
plugins.bounds: Would send signed, expiring attachment/CDN URLs to seven arbitrary external services; generic external network and referrer leakage.

plugins.name: reviewDB
plugins.summary: Third-party user/server review service with review lists, votes, reports, blocks and notification polling.
plugins.bounds: fetch to an external host, OAuth2 identify token persisted locally, authorization headers and background polling; violates credential/session and generic-network boundaries.

plugins.name: roleColorEverywhere
plugins.summary: Apply loaded member and role colors/gradients to mentions, member-list headers, voice users, reactors, poll results and optionally message bodies.
plugins.bounds: Reads existing guild member/role stores only; appearance-only; optional message saturation 0-100.

implementation.limitations: Loaded role colors for authors, replies, mentions, member/voice/reaction rows; poll voter identities and unloaded metadata remain unavailable.

plugins.name: secretRingTone
plugins.summary: Force the alternate secret call ringtone.
plugins.bounds: Serein has no ringtone subsystem; would require a bundled audio asset plus call-audio work for low value.

plugins.name: sendTimestamps
plugins.summary: Composer timestamp insertion and Discord timestamp formatting already exist natively.
plugins.bounds: Native @time picker with nine documented styles; never sends on confirm; follows the 2000-character draft budget.

plugins.name: serverInfo
plugins.summary: Read-only guild info modal over already-loaded guild, channel, role, member, friend, blocked and ignored data.
plugins.bounds: Local stores; mutual-member tabs may issue bounded GUILD_MEMBERS_REQUEST chunks; cap visible rows and page size.

implementation.limitations: Read-only loaded guild/channel data and account-wide relationship counts. No owner, joined-at, vanity, locale, verification, boosts, roles, membership-filtered/mutual tabs, images or member fetches.

plugins.name: serverListIndicators
plugins.summary: Server-list badge showing the online friend count and/or joined guild count.
plugins.bounds: Counts over already-loaded presences, relationships and guilds only; no fetch.

implementation.limitations: One compact tile for loaded online-friend and guild counts. Loaded data only; no upstream mode preference, pending joins or unloaded presences.

plugins.name: shikiCodeblocks.desktop
plugins.summary: Replace Discord codeblocks with Shiki/VS Code-style highlighting via a worker and onigasm WASM.
plugins.bounds: Runtime CDN fetch of language JSON, grammars and themes, multi-MB bundled assets and worker IPC; violates generic-network and bounded-payload policy.

plugins.name: showAllMessageButtons
plugins.summary: Always show message delete, pin and react affordances without requiring Shift.
plugins.bounds: Each click remains an explicit user action revalidated by permissions; no bulk or automatic actions; keep confirmation for destructive operations.

plugins.name: showConnections
plugins.summary: Show connected-account icons from the loaded user profile in popouts and the profile modal.
plugins.bounds: Decoder bounds connected_accounts at 16; drop the upstream GitHub organization fetch; external links stay behind the native confirmation.

plugins.name: showHiddenChannels
plugins.summary: List and render channels the account lacks VIEW_CHANNEL for, including topic, permission overwrites and last activity.
plugins.bounds: Serein deliberately drops obfuscated channels and threads (flags 0x20000) in READY and gateway events; porting requires retaining hidden records and bypassing VIEW_CHANNEL gating.

plugins.name: showHiddenThings
plugins.summary: Remove permission gates for moderator view, invites-paused, discovery filters and other moderator-only affordances.
plugins.bounds: Permission and UI gate bypass; only the timeout icon is a separable display-only feature.
plugins.target: none (timeout indicator alone: crates/ui/src/timeline.rs author badges)

plugins.name: showMeYourName
plugins.summary: Compose custom, friend, server, display and username permutations across messages, replies, mentions, member list, typing, reactions and popouts.
plugins.bounds: Reads local user/member/relationship stores; custom nickname map kept in bounded local storage (id -> short string); display-only with no fetch.

implementation.limitations: Optional private friend nickname precedence over server nickname through existing naming paths. No custom-name map or full per-surface permutations; webhook labels and other native surfaces remain unchanged.

plugins.name: showTimeoutDuration
plugins.summary: Show remaining timeout duration next to the timeout icon or inside its tooltip.
plugins.bounds: Derived from member communication_disabled_until and the local clock; one countdown per visible message; no fetch.

implementation.limitations: Displays remaining timeout only when a matching moderation member record is already loaded; ordinary chat member rows usually lack it and nothing is inferred.

plugins.name: silentMessageToggle
plugins.summary: Quiet sending via a leading @silent marker is already native.
plugins.bounds: Leading @silent marker with quiet-send indicator; 2000-character admission includes marker allowance; suppresses OS alerts while keeping badges.

plugins.name: silentTyping
plugins.summary: Suppress outbound TYPING_START indicators with per-location consent lists, and optionally hide others' indicators.
plugins.bounds: Global/guild/channel allow or deny lists plus temporary-enable windows; inbound typing unchanged; existing typing state bounded at 16 direct and 16 sent entries.

implementation.surface: Chat preferences and outbound typing policy
implementation.limitations: Device-local outbound suppression with normal/inverted behavior and at most 64 channel/guild exceptions. No temporary-enable windows or hiding incoming indicators.

plugins.name: sortFriendRequests
plugins.summary: Sort friend requests by receipt date and optionally show the date label.
plugins.bounds: Local relationship since values only; formatting and ordering; no fetch.

implementation.surface: Friends request rows plus relationship protocol/core
implementation.limitations: Dated pending requests sort newest-first and show a local Added MM/DD/YY label; absent/malformed restricted since data falls back to alphabetical order. No fetch or display preference.

plugins.name: spotifyCrack
plugins.summary: Spoof Spotify premium to unlock listen-along, disable auto-pause and keep activity while idle.
plugins.bounds: Payment and terms circumvention; Serein has no Spotify session or premium state to unlock.

plugins.name: spotifyShareCommands
plugins.summary: Insert /track, /album and /artist links for the current Spotify activity.
plugins.bounds: Only if presence retains track/album/artist ids; build the URL locally and insert into the composer; no Spotify API call.
plugins.target: crates/model presence activity and composer insertion

plugins.name: startupTimings
plugins.summary: Developer settings page listing boot-phase timing deltas.
plugins.bounds: Local diagnostics only; read-only table; no network or extra persistence.

implementation.limitations: Read-only process-relative phase list capped at eight entries and stopped after the first frame; not a complete profiler or persistent timing history.

plugins.name: stickerPaste
plugins.summary: Sticker picker inserts the chosen sticker into the composer instead of sending it immediately.
plugins.bounds: Composer insertion; the user still confirms send; uses the existing bounded sticker picker data.

plugins.name: streamerModeOnStream
plugins.summary: Enable streamer-mode privacy while the local account is streaming and disable it when the stream ends.
plugins.bounds: Local stream state only; automatic privacy change requires explicit opt-in and a visible indicator.

plugins.name: superReactionTweaks
plugins.summary: Default the reaction picker to super reactions when premium is available and cap simultaneous burst animations.
plugins.bounds: Local UI/animation budget 0-100 with a local premium check; no protocol change or extra data.

plugins.name: textReplace
plugins.summary: Literal/regex replacement rules with scopes, import/export, outgoing edits and incoming message rewrites.
plugins.bounds: Ported as Text Commands: at most 8 literal rules and 8 tags, 4 KiB per field, 64 KiB stored JSON; no regex, scopes, incoming rewrite or automatic send.

implementation.limitations: Up to eight literal rules; Apply only; no regex or incoming rewrite.

plugins.name: themeAttributes
plugins.summary: Injects DOM data attributes and avatar CSS variables for theme selectors.
plugins.bounds: Serein themes expose palette and shared style tokens only; egui has no DOM, CSS selectors or per-element attributes.

plugins.name: translate
plugins.summary: Inline Google/DeepL/Kagi translation with optional API keys and message replacement.
plugins.bounds: Ported as External Search Tools: reviewed HTTPS Google/DeepL browser URL, 1 KiB selected text, fixed provider allowlist; no inline API, keys or replacement.

implementation.limitations: Reviewed browser translation URL; no inline API translation.

plugins.name: typingIndicator
plugins.summary: Typing dots and avatars per channel row and thread spine, with muted/blocked/current-channel settings.
plugins.bounds: Serein paints native dots and up to three names for the selected channel only; no avatars, per-channel rows, muted/blocked toggles or include-current setting.

plugins.name: typingTweaks
plugins.summary: Adds avatars, role colours, alternate several-user formatting and am-I-typing to the typing indicator.
plugins.bounds: Use only already-loaded avatars, member roles and typing IDs; keep the existing three-name strip, selected-channel scope and bounded repaint schedule. No fetch.

implementation.limitations: Already-loaded member role colors and corrected several-user conjunction formatting. No avatars or am-I-typing feature; the selected-channel bounded name strip remains.

plugins.name: unindent
plugins.summary: Dedents fenced code blocks on send and edit.
plugins.bounds: Ported as Offline Composer Tools: expands body tabs, removes common space indentation from complete multiline fences, leaves prose and unmatched fences; composer Apply only.

implementation.limitations: Apply-reviewed fenced-code unindent.

plugins.name: unlockedAvatarZoom
plugins.summary: Raises the avatar crop tool zoom slider maximum.
plugins.bounds: Serein accepts and validates avatar images but has no crop or zoom editor; this needs a new interactive media-editing surface.

plugins.name: unsuppressEmbeds
plugins.summary: Context action toggles the embed-suppressed message flag through a message PATCH.
plugins.bounds: One loaded message per explicit action; preserve all other flags; require ownership or EMBED_LINKS where applicable; optimistic update with server reconciliation. No bulk or automatic calls.

plugins.name: userMessagesPronouns
plugins.summary: Shows profile pronouns beside message timestamps or compact usernames.
plugins.bounds: Cache-only lookup of already-loaded profile pronouns; lowercase/capitalized and show-self settings; trim, strip controls, cap at 256 bytes; skip bots and system messages. No background profile fetch.

implementation.limitations: Cache-only lowercase pronouns, trimmed/control-stripped and capped at 256 bytes for human non-webhook, non-system authors. No profile fetch or capitalization/show-self preferences.

plugins.name: userVoiceShow
plugins.summary: Speaker badge for users in voice shown in profiles, member lists, messages and friends lists.
plugins.bounds: Serein already uses bounded visible-call roster data for badges in member lists, profiles, friends and DM/channel rows; no per-view toggles.

plugins.name: usrbg
plugins.summary: Fetches the USRBG user map and substitutes third-party banners and voice backgrounds.
plugins.bounds: Requires a third-party API, remote banner media and a new external-art cache; no existing provider or consent path.

plugins.name: validReply
plugins.summary: Fetches an unloaded replied-to message when its placeholder is hovered.
plugins.bounds: Serein already shows 'Earlier message · View original' and can load and jump to the source through its bounded history path; no hover-triggered fetch.

plugins.name: validUser
plugins.summary: Fetches unknown mentioned users on hover and rerenders the mention with their profile data.
plugins.bounds: One bounded user/profile request per unknown ID with a small negative/positive cache and rate-limit handling; no mention rewriting beyond the requested user; no bulk prefetch.

plugins.name: vcDoubleClick
plugins.summary: Requires a double click, with a short timer, to join a voice channel.
plugins.bounds: Input-only local preference; 500 ms per-channel window; preserve keyboard and active-call behavior; no network or data change.

plugins.name: vcNarrator
plugins.summary: Announces voice join, leave, move and self mute/deafen through speech synthesis.
plugins.bounds: Serein has voice-state events but no TTS engine, narrator voice selection, or audio-output overlap/ducking policy.

plugins.name: viewIcons
plugins.summary: Opens user avatars, banners and decorations, plus server and group icons, from profiles and context menus.
plugins.bounds: Serein already opens profile avatars and banners in its media viewer; missing user/server/group context entries, avatar-decoration viewer and server-icon viewer.

plugins.name: viewRaw
plugins.summary: Raw JSON inspector and copy action for messages, channels, guilds, roles and profiles.
plugins.bounds: Ported as ViewRaw — safe message view: selected message text plus public IDs, 4,000-byte native elements, 64 KiB panel, 256 KiB response budget; no raw host objects.

implementation.limitations: Selected text/public IDs, not raw private host objects.

plugins.name: voiceDownload
plugins.summary: Adds download or open-in-browser access to voice-message audio.
plugins.bounds: Serein's voice-message context menu already offers Download and Open original under its normal download limits.

plugins.name: voiceMessages
plugins.summary: Records or uploads audio, generates a waveform, remuxes to OggOpus and sends a voice-message attachment.
plugins.bounds: Requires microphone capture, audio encoding/remux, waveform generation, upload and voice-message flag handling; Serein has playback but no recording/send pipeline.

plugins.name: volumeBooster
plugins.summary: Allows per-user and stream playback volume above 200 percent.
plugins.bounds: Raise only the local gain cap, for example to 400-500 percent; keep synchronized/canonical service volume at 200; preserve mute restore behavior; warn about clipping and hearing risk.

implementation.limitations: Explicit local participant/stream gain up to 400 percent with clipping/hearing warning; canonical wire/extension/global gain remains capped at 200 percent.

plugins.name: webContextMenus.web
plugins.summary: Re-adds browser link, image and text-input context menus through DOM handlers and clipboard APIs.
plugins.bounds: Serein uses native egui context menus; there is no DOM, browser menu handler or equivalent web clipboard layer.

plugins.name: webKeybinds.web
plugins.summary: Restores browser title-bar navigation, blocked tab shortcuts and the Ctrl/Cmd-comma settings shortcut.
plugins.bounds: Serein already owns native keybinds and window chrome; the browser/Electron keybind integration has no equivalent.

plugins.name: webPWA.browser
plugins.summary: Injects a PWA manifest, app badge, global-keybind bridge and Discord custom title bar.
plugins.bounds: Native desktop app; no PWA install flow, browser app badge or web title-bar layer.

plugins.name: webScreenShare.browser
plugins.summary: Wraps getDisplayMedia with resolution, frame-rate, content-hint and system-audio choices.
plugins.bounds: Serein already has a native source picker with resolution, fps, cursor and system audio plus native bitrate selection; content-hint and stream-preview toggle remain absent.

plugins.name: webScreenShareFixes.web
plugins.summary: Raises the WebRTC bitrate cap, adds stereo and fixes detached-source CPU growth.
plugins.bounds: Serein's native screen-share path already computes up to 16 Mbps and does not use the Chromium/Electron WebRTC path this patch targets.

plugins.name: whoReacted
plugins.summary: Fetches reaction users and renders their avatars next to each reaction.
plugins.bounds: Serein's reaction inspect popup already fetches and names reactors within a bounded queue; inline avatars are absent but would reuse already-fetched users.

plugins.name: xsOverlay
plugins.summary: Forwards Discord notifications to the XSOverlay VR app over a local WebSocket or UDP bridge.
plugins.bounds: Requires a third-party XSOverlay protocol, local socket bridge and notification payload mapping; no such integration exists.

plugins.name: youtubeAdblock.desktop
plugins.summary: Injects an AdGuard script into YouTube embed frames and the WatchTogether activity.
plugins.bounds: Requires an Electron frame-created hook and embedded YouTube/WatchTogether webview; Serein has neither.

implementation_note: Package existence and offline checks do not imply complete upstream parity or live Discord compatibility. MessageLogger lifecycle review completed with synthetic tests; raw REST-vs-gateway subsequent body-application behavior remains outside this feature guarantee.
